title: Oedipus fulfills the prophecy by fleeing it

tellings.quote: there's this prophecy that this young prince of Thieves is going to grow up and murder his father and marry his mother

plain: In the Greek myth of Oedipus, a prophecy says a young prince of Thebes "is going to grow up and murder his father and marry his mother," and the very steps taken to escape it are what bring it about. The writer Eric Wargo, who studies prophetic dreams, retells the myth to Michels, with a nod to Sigmund Freud. He uses it to make a point about foresight: a glimpse of the future can end up shaping the actions that make it come true.
